label: VG310 24-port FXS voice gateway
description: 1U Cisco IOS-based analog voice gateway with 24 FXS voice ports presented on an RJ-21 connector, two 10/100/1000BASE-T gigabit Ethernet ports and one EHWIC slot for PSTN or WAN uplinks.
notes: Cisco hardware installation guide: chassis provides two 10/100/1000BASE-T gigabit Ethernet ports, an EHWIC slot plus VIC/VWIC slots, external compact flash, AC and DC power inputs on the VG310. The 24 FXS ports (RJ-21) are analog and not modelled; the VG320 is the 48-port sibling. Runs Cisco IOS with CLI/SNMPv3, PVDM3 DSP for transcoding and conferencing, T.38 fax, SRTP/TLS. The EHWIC/VIC slots are empty by default and cannot be modelled as fixed ports.
